message.content: YurikoYamamoto expresses enthusiasm about experimenting with binaural tones, describing it as "adding a whole new dimension to our music." She indicates excitement about trying it out and hopes to see how it blends with their instruments, suggesting that she sees this as a fun and innovative approach to enhancing their sound. Her comments reflect a positive attitude towards incorporating binaural tones into their musical practice, seeing it as a potential source of fresh inspiration and a way to create a unique listening experience for their audience.
